steps.detail: Unscrew the fasteners on the bottom with a screwdriver and lift off the bottom panel to expose the motherboard.
steps.title: Open bottom cover

steps.detail: Release the memory slot clips and lift the existing SO-DIMM out of the slot.
steps.title: Remove old RAM stick

steps.detail: Align the first green SO-DIMM to the slot and press it in until seated.
steps.title: Install first RAM stick

steps.detail: Align the second green SO-DIMM to the remaining slot and press it in until seated.
steps.title: Install second RAM stick

steps.detail: Place the bottom cover back on the chassis and reinstall and tighten the case screws.
steps.title: Close bottom cover

task: Replace the RAM in a mini PC
